keyword: do not substitute a diesel pump row for an electric pump

title.en: Do Not Copy a Diesel Catalogue Row onto an Electric Order
title.zh: 不要把柴油目录行抄到电动订单上

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints electric and diesel pumps on separate pages. Copying one table onto the other changes the machine you think you ordered.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动泵和柴油泵印在不同页面。把一张表抄到另一张上，会改变你以为订下的机器。

h1.en: Keep the Diesel Sheet Off the Electric Purchase Order
h1.zh: 电动采购单上不要套用柴油表

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai will not treat a diesel page as the diesel version of the electric page with the same numeral. Electric 50 prints a 55 kW motor, 26 m³/h and three stone-distance rows. Diesel 50 prints 6105 / 99 kW, 30 m³/h, 30 MPa and 150 m / 450 m. An order must name one path. Sending both tables as if they were one machine leaves Xingtai without a model to quote.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）不会把柴油页当成同数字电动页的柴油版。电动50印 55 kW 电机、26 m³/h 和三行石子距离。柴油50印 6105 / 99 kW、30 m³/h、30 MPa、150 m / 450 m。订单必须点明一条路径。两张表当成一台机器发出去，邢台就没有可报价的型号。

heading.en: A pair that shares a weight and nothing else
heading.zh: 一对只共享重量的型号

body.en: Electric 50 and Diesel 40 both print 2800 kg. Electric 50 is 55 kW electric, 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm. Diesel 40 is 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. Matching the kilograms is not an order.
body.zh: 电动50和柴油40都印 2800 kg。电动50是电动 55 kW，外形 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm。柴油40是 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h，外形 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm。对上公斤数不是一张订单。

heading.en: What to write when you are still deciding

body.en: Send two inquiries, or one note with two paths and a sentence that says which condition applies: grid able to feed the motor, or diesel only. Do not merge pressure or distance. Ask [/en/contact/](/en/contact/) to price the path you select.
body.zh: 发两封询盘，或在一封里写两条路径，并用一句话说明条件：电网能供给电机，或只能用柴油。不要合并压力或距离。请 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/) 对你选定的路径报价。

heading.zh: 外形相同，仍然是两台机器

body.en: Electric 60 and Electric 80 both print 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. Weights are 3300 kg and 6000 kg, motors 90 kW and 110 kW. That pair is electric-to-electric, and it still must not be collapsed. A diesel copy of either page is a third sheet.
body.zh: 电动60和电动80都印外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。重量是 3300 kg 和 6000 kg，电机是 90 kW 和 110 kW。这一对都是电动，仍然不能并成一台。它们各自的柴油对照又是第三张表。

question.zh: 柴油40是电动40的柴油版吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 prints 45 kW, 21 m³/h and two stone rows. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW and 26 m³/h.
answer.zh: 不是。电动40印 45 kW、21 m³/h 和两行石子距离。柴油40印 4108 / 66 kW 和 26 m³/h。

question.en: May I ask for both quotes?
question.zh: 可以同时要两个报价吗？

answer.en: Yes, if each quote names its own path. Hebei Pinjin Machinery still confirms price only by inquiry.
answer.zh: 可以，只要每个报价写明自己的路径。河北品锦机械仍然只通过询盘确认价格。

question.en: Does equal weight mean equal freight class on the site?
question.zh: 重量相同是否表示本站印了相同运费等级？

answer.en: No freight class is printed. Send dimensions from the page you order.
answer.zh: 没有印运费等级。请发送你所订页面上的外形。

question.en: Where do I send the choice?

answer.en: The Xingtai contact page, with the slug.
answer.zh: 邢台询盘页，并附上型号地址。
